styledChannelReceipts: text-fill-pinned-geometry-admitted: label.width — the overlay-cluster geometry exclusion is LIFTED for this one axis. The part's own reported box equals its ancestor root's CONTENT box in every enabled default-plane combo (default: label 24px == root content box 24px), and that content box takes 2 distinct values spanning 16px (≥ one em of this part's 12px font): a box that moved WITH a parent that moved is filling it, not measuring its own glyphs. No box on the chain label → root measures the browser viewport (900px) or the capture stage content box (288px) on this axis, and none of them is viewport-refused — the number is the library's, not the harness's.

frontierReceipts: closed-shadow-root-limit: 0 suspected closed shadow root(s) named above. A closed shadow root is UNREACHABLE from script (el.shadowRoot === null), so nothing about a closed host's interior is captured or carried; the reader names the two signatures of its absence it can see (a custom-element leaf that paints a box; a non-replaced display:inline leaf with a non-zero content box) and NAMES AS UNDETECTABLE the third — a closed root on a plain element blockified by a flex/grid parent, which no computed style distinguishes from an empty item. The decisive probe (attachShadow throwing NotSupportedError) mutates the page on its negative path and would break the double-run byte-identity self-check; it is refused, not forgotten.

pseudo-elements-read: the reader looks at ::before, ::after, ::marker, ::placeholder — measured here on no part. Reading is not carrying: the bounded decor grammar promotes ::before/::after only, so every other pseudo the reader records is a MEASUREMENT with no carriage — named, never silently dropped.

pseudo-element-not-read: ::selection — REFUSED BY NAME, not measured: transient user state — it paints only while a selection exists, and the capture drives prop combos and pseudo-class states, never a pointer drag; there is also no canvas spelling for a selection highlight

pseudo-element-not-read: ::backdrop — REFUSED BY NAME, not measured: paints only for an element promoted to the TOP LAYER (dialog.showModal() / popover), which the sweep never calls — measured: getComputedStyle(dialog, "::backdrop") reads the authored scrim ONLY after showModal(). The canvas DOES have a spelling (a scrim rectangle), so this is a reader gap worth closing, not a canvas limit
